# Robotics Directory

> Comprehensive static directory of robots with advanced search, category filtering, side-by-side comparison, and a guided finder. 1,200+ robots across 8 categories, available in 28 languages.

## Main Pages

- [Homepage](https://robodirectory.huskynarr.de/): The main catalog containing 1,200+ robots across 8 categories.
- [Robot Finder](https://robodirectory.huskynarr.de/finder/): Guided interactive recommendation wizard matching users to robots by purpose, budget, and specs.
- [Directory Statistics](https://robodirectory.huskynarr.de/stats/): Visual analytics, category distributions, price statistics, and manufacturer metrics.

## Category Landing Pages

- [Humanoid Robots](https://robodirectory.huskynarr.de/category/humanoid/): Bipedal and wheeled human-like platforms for industrial, research, and companion use.
- [Quadruped Robots](https://robodirectory.huskynarr.de/category/quadruped/): Robodogs, wheeled-legged systems, and inspection crawlers.
- [Companion Robots](https://robodirectory.huskynarr.de/category/companion/): Social robots, tabletop assistants, and robotic pets.
- [Cleaning Robots](https://robodirectory.huskynarr.de/category/cleaning/): Autonomous vacuums, mops, commercial scrubbers, and industrial cleaners.
- [Outdoor Robots](https://robodirectory.huskynarr.de/category/outdoor/): Robotic lawn mowers, snow clearers, pool cleaners, and sidewalk delivery systems.
- [Educational Robots](https://robodirectory.huskynarr.de/category/educational/): MINT/STEM platforms, programmable arm kits, and toy/coding packages.
- [Smart Home Robots](https://robodirectory.huskynarr.de/category/smarthome/): Delivery AMRs, automated kitchen cooks, and telepresence systems.
- [Robotic Arms](https://robodirectory.huskynarr.de/category/robotic-arm/): Desktop and industrial robotic arms for dev, service, and research.

## Feeds

- [RSS: Latest robots](https://robodirectory.huskynarr.de/rss.xml): Newest robots added across all categories.
- [RSS per category](https://robodirectory.huskynarr.de/feed/humanoid.xml): e.g. latest humanoid robots (replace the category slug for others).

## Data & Specifications

All robots have detailed specification sheets containing:
- Manufacturer and Model details
- Pricing (numeric/structured currencies)
- Physical properties (weight, size dimensions)
- Operational specs (battery life, runtime, speed, degrees of freedom, payload capacity, IP rating, terrain profiles)
- Interactive comparison links (compare up to 4 models side-by-side)

## Developer Resources

- [Sitemap](https://robodirectory.huskynarr.de/sitemap-index.xml): Index of all static pages and robot URL endpoints.
- [Image Sitemap](https://robodirectory.huskynarr.de/sitemap-images.xml): Robot images for indexation in image search.
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/Huskynarr/robotics-directory): Open-source source code and data.
